recognize_zh: 單一顆高核質比的母細胞，染色質細緻，核上可見散在細小嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），細胞質深藍；在剛打過 G-CSF 的移植後病人，這種帶淡顆粒的「再生性」母細胞屬生長因子效應，但本圖未見中性球的毒性顆粒或 Döhle 小體。
features: Single intermediate-to-large blast-like cell with high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin
Fine azurophilic granules scattered over the nucleus/cytoplasm
Thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale crescent at one edge
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and rare teardrop forms; platelets markedly reduced
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single intermediate-to-large immature myeloid cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and a thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing scattered fine azurophilic granules. A pale crescent is seen at one edge of the cytoplasm; definite Döhle bodies cannot be resolved with confidence in this cell. No neutrophils are present in this field, so the toxic granulation and Döhle bodies described in the neutrophils cannot be evaluated here, and platelets are markedly decreased. In a post-transplant patient recently given G-CSF, a rare circulating granulated blast is suggestive of growth factor effect, but correlation with blast percentage trend and marrow/MRD studies is required to exclude relapse.

ddx.dx: Relapsed acute leukemia (Ph+ ALL or therapy-related AML)
ddx.vs: Relapse shows a persistent or rising blast population with an aberrant immunophenotype/MRD positivity, whereas G-CSF-related blasts are transient, few, granulated and accompanied by a left-shifted maturing granulocytic series.

ddx.dx: Infection-related left shift with toxic changes
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps (toxic granulation, Döhle bodies); history of recent G-CSF and the transient course favor growth factor effect.
Shows larger, sharply defined Döhle-like inclusions in all neutrophils together with giant platelets, without circulating blasts.
